item.title: Issue #2867 created
item.description:
`fn:current` everywhere

With #2858, the custom syntax context value was introduced for defaults of function parameters.

It may be difficult for users to understand the difference between . and context value. Second, context value can only be used on top level (we cannot write data(context value).

If a path step or a predicate changes the focus, XQuery gives you no way back to the value the query was started with; you have to remember to bind it to a variable instead, which is often a bit tedious, even more with the new pipeline operator ->. This is why I think we should make fn:current available everywhere, and not restrict it to XSLT anymore.
